name: Submit URL And Wait
description: Submit a URL to VMRay, wait until the analysis has finished and return the results. Consumes quota.

sample_url.description: URL to submit for detonation. VMRay opens it in a browser and also analyses what it downloads.
sample_url.title: URL

reanalyze.description: If set to true, known samples will be re-analyzed on submission. This is enabled by default.
reanalyze.title: Re-analyze known samples

tags.description: Tags to attach to the sample.
tags.title: Tags

shareable.description: If set to true, the hash of the sample will be shared with VirusTotal.
shareable.title: Share with VirusTotal

max_recursive_samples.description: The maximum amount of recursive samples (files found inside the sample) which will be analyzed, at most 10. 0 disables recursion.
max_recursive_samples.title: Max recursive samples

max_jobs.description: Limits the amount of jobs that can be created by jobrules for a submission.
max_jobs.title: Max jobs

enable_reputation.description: If set to true, reputation lookups will be performed for submitted samples and analysis artifacts (file hash and URL lookups) by the VMRay cloud reputation service and additional third party services. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
enable_reputation.title: Enable reputation lookups

enable_whois.description: If set to true, domains seen during analyses are queried with external WHOIS service. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
enable_whois.title: Enable WHOIS

analyzer_mode.description: Specifies which types of analyzers will be used for analyzing this sample. Supported strings are 'reputation', 'reputation_static', 'reputation_static_dynamic', 'static_dynamic', and 'static'. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
analyzer_mode.title: Analyzer mode

known_malicious.description: If set to true, triage will be used to pre-filter known malicious samples by results of reputation lookup (if allowed) and static analysis. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
known_malicious.title: Pre-filter known malicious

known_benign.description: If set to true, triage will be used to pre-filter known benign samples by results of reputation lookup (if allowed) and static analysis. The user analyzer setting is used as default value for this parameter.
known_benign.title: Pre-filter known benign

net_scheme_name.description: Name of the network scheme to analyze with.
net_scheme_name.title: Network scheme name

query_retry_wait.description: The amount of seconds to wait between two checks of whether the analysis has finished.
query_retry_wait.title: Poll interval (s)

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for every submission to finish, then the action stops and takes the timed_out branch.
timeout.title: Wait timeout (s)

Submission.description: One submission object, as GET /submission/{id} returns it once finished.
Submission.title: Submission

submission_ids.description: IDs of the finished submissions — input for Build Report.
submission_ids.title: Submission IDs

sample_ids.description: Distinct sample_ids of the finished submissions — input for Build Report and the Get Sample actions.
sample_ids.title: Sample IDs

pending_submission_ids.description: Submissions still running when the wait timed out.
pending_submission_ids.title: Pending Submission IDs

timed_out.description: True when the wait timed out before every submission finished.
timed_out.title: Timed Out

failed_submission_ids.description: Submissions that finished with an error, or could not be followed.
failed_submission_ids.title: Failed Submission IDs

errors.description: Errors VMRay returned on submit, and why a submission failed.
errors.title: Errors
